- Timeline: 3-week POC kickoff next Monday (9/21) with a one-week baseline run, then 2 weeks of tuning + observability.
- Owners: FintechX: Alex (technical lead) / Priya (procurement). Redwood: me (AM) + Jordan (runtime lead) + Sean (SRE).

Next steps:
1) Confirm kickoff: Alex / Priya, can you confirm 9/21 as the POC start?
2) Jordan / Sean: can you review the observability checklist and confirm owners for dashboard builds + log exports by EOD Friday?

Thanks. I'll schedule a 30m kickoff calendar invite once we have confirmation.

Best,
Marissa

Thanks, adding technical details on the observability plan below. High-level plan (POC observability):

1) Dashboards (Datadog recommended):
   - POC Overview dashboard: request rate, avg latency, p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate, throughput (tokens/s), cost per 1k tokens (est).
   - Model runtime dashboard: per-worker GPU utilization, GPU memory, batch size distribution, KV cache hit rate.
   - Tracing & tails: top 10 slowest request traces with annotation for model variant, sequence length, and batching decision.

2) Tracing and log export:
   - Instrument RPCs with OpenTelemetry traces. We will provide a tracing shim for your client that forwards spans to Datadog.
   - Export request/response metadata (no PII): request_id, timestamp, model_version, seq_len, batch_size, tokens_consumed, latency_ms, error_code.
   - Export KV cache metrics as a separate metric stream (cache_hits, cache_misses, hit_latency_ms).

3) Alerts and SLOs:
   - Alert rules to create: p95 latency > 450ms for >5m; request_error_rate > 0.5% sustained over 10m; GPU_utilization > 90% for 5m.
   - SLOs: p95 latency and error rate with burn-rate style alerts for POC.

4) Log retention & forwarders:
   - Short-term: push structured request logs to your Splunk index (90 days).
   - Long-term: aggregated daily metrics exported to your S3 bucket for cost analysis.

5) Ownership & timeline:
   - By EOD Fri (9/18): Jordan to deliver Datadog dashboard JSON + OpenTelemetry shim; Sean to share Splunk ingestion example.
   - Week 0 (9/21): baseline run (no quantization) to capture steady-state metrics.
   - Week 1-2: tuning: batching/quantization/kv cache; RB meetings on Wed to review dashboards.

Notes / constraints: we will avoid sending full request/response payloads; only metadata and traces. Any PI/PHI must be redacted per your security policy.

I'll attach the dashboard JSONs to the Drive link once ready.

Jordan
Runtime Lead, Redwood Inference
